headword: {白日|はくじつ}の{下|もと}に{晒|さら}す
reading: はくじつのもとにさらす
gloss: to bring to light; expose to public view

definitions.gloss: to bring to light; expose to public view
definitions.explanation: To reveal something hidden — usually wrongdoing, a secret, or the truth — so that everyone can see it. {白日|はくじつ} is the bright daylight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白日|はくじつ}の{下|もと}に{晒|さら}す。
examples.english: To bring the wrongdoing to light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに{白日|はくじつ}の{下|もと}に{晒|さら}された。
examples.english: The truth was finally exposed to public view.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{隠|かく}されて→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧きた⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白日|はくじつ}の{下|もと}に{晒|さら}した。
examples.english: The report brought to light a corporate secret that had been hidden for many years.

notes:
{白日|はくじつ} literally means 'bright daylight.' The idiom pictures dragging a hidden thing out into full sunlight where it can no longer be concealed. Almost always used of wrongdoing, scandals, or uncomfortable truths.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白日|はくじつ}の{下|もと}に{晒|さら}す: to expose corruption
- ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{白日|はくじつ}の{下|もと}に{晒|さら}される: the truth comes to light

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {明|あき}るみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to bring to light — more neutral and everyday
- ⟦{暴|あば}く→暴く：04607_abaku⟧: to expose; uncover — a single verb, often of secrets or crimes
